subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a core Control UI admin upload flow for agent avatars, or keep avatar changes limited to existing identity/config/file-editing paths until a safer upload contract is designed?
rationale: The missing UI path is real, but accepting browser-supplied image bytes and writing them into agent workspaces changes a security-sensitive admin surface and persistent identity state.

options.title: Approve a bounded upload contract
options.body: Add an admin-only avatar upload path with explicit auth scope, size/type sniffing, workspace containment, overwrite cleanup, identity persistence, and Control UI proof.

options.title: Reuse existing identity/file editing
options.body: Keep avatar changes on existing `agents.update` and `agents.files.set` paths and improve UI guidance without adding binary uploads yet.

options.title: Defer avatar management
options.body: Leave this as product debt until broader Control UI identity customization is prioritized.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded upload contract
recommendation.body: Add an admin-only avatar upload path with explicit auth scope, size/type sniffing, workspace containment, overwrite cleanup, identity persistence, and Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the core avatar support and is the strongest owner signal for deciding the avatar/security contract.
